title: Dark Mode
content: Create elegant dark mode using dark backgrounds (bg-gray-900 or bg-slate-900 for main, bg-gray-800 for cards). Use off-white text (text-gray-100) for primary content and muted gray (text-gray-400) for secondary text. Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use muted accent colors - desaturate bright colors slightly. Add subtle borders (border-gray-700) to define sections. Use darker shadows that blend with background. Include smooth transitions when switching themes. Avoid pure black (#000) and pure white (#fff).

variants.simple: Create dark theme with dark backgrounds and light text.
variants.detailed: Create elegant dark mode using dark backgrounds (bg-gray-900 or bg-slate-900 for main, bg-gray-800 for cards). Use off-white text (text-gray-100) for primary content and muted gray (text-gray-400) for secondary text. Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use muted accent colors - desaturate bright colors slightly. Add subtle borders (border-gray-700) to define sections. Use darker shadows that blend with background. Include smooth transitions when switching themes. Avoid pure black (#000) and pure white (#fff).
variants.advanced: Create elegant dark mode using dark backgrounds (bg-gray-900 or bg-slate-900 for main, bg-gray-800 for cards). Use off-white text (text-gray-100) for primary content and muted gray (text-gray-400) for secondary text. Ensure WCAG AAA 7:1 contrast ratio for body text, 4.5:1 for large text. Use muted accent colors - desaturate bright colors by 10-20% to reduce eye strain. Add subtle borders (border-gray-700) to define sections without harsh lines. Use colored shadows (shadow-blue-900/20) that complement the theme. Implement prefers-color-scheme media query for system preference detection. Store user preference in localStorage. Add smooth color-scheme transitions (duration-300) to prevent flash. Avoid pure black (#000) which causes halation - use bg-gray-950 maximum. Test all states: links visited/hover/active, form validation colors, disabled states. Ensure charts, graphs, and data visualizations adapt properly. Add dark mode variants for images where needed.
